verdict.rationale: A self-hosted deployment option is a fair question for a hosted email API service. The only relevant evidence is a single community comment saying AgentMail's enterprise options include Bring Your Own Cloud, which suggests deployment into customer infrastructure for enterprise buyers only. Everything else in the pack describes a hosted SaaS with a hosted API and hosted MCP endpoint. Missing for 10: first-party documentation of a self-hosting or BYOC deployment, availability outside enterprise contracts, installation and operations guidance, any open-source or downloadable core, and hands-on corroboration.
